## Summary

Describe the public-facing change and why it belongs in this repository.

## Verification

List the checks run for this change.

## Public disclosure checklist

- [ ] The title, branch name, commit messages, description, diff, and test output are suitable for a public repository.
- [ ] No private ticket identifiers or links, internal planning artifacts, credentials, account data, or unpublished operational details are included.
- [ ] A maintainer reviewed the complete public PR surface, not only the runtime code.
